name: zkUSD Dollar
oneLiner: zkUSD is a Goal3 sportsbook dollar token on ZKsync Era, redeemed 1:1 to USDC; the protocol claims overcollateralization but composition is undisclosed.
collateral: Collateralized assets held within the Goal3 sportsbook on ZKsync Era; backing is asserted as algorithmically over-collateralized and provable on-chain, but the exact composition of accepted collateral is not publicly itemized.
pegMechanism: Issued and redeemed through the Goal3 Portal at 1 zkUSD = 1 USDC; the protocol claims to maintain over-collateralization of zkUSD circulating supply against assets held by Goal3 on ZKsync Era.

oracleRisk.summary: Public docs reviewed for Goal3 zkUSD do not identify the collateral oracle setup or failure handling.

notices.title: Reserve composition not publicly itemized
notices.message: Goal3 documents zkUSD as algorithmically over-collateralized by assets held in the sportsbook, but the specific accepted collateral assets and collateralization ratio are not published. The only documented holder exit is 1:1 redemption to USDC through the Goal3 Portal.

reserves.name: Goal3 sportsbook collateral pool (composition not disclosed)

mintAuthority.summary: zkUSD is issued only through the Goal3 Portal on ZKsync Era; the token's owner() is EOA 0x49a67aff9d3807351b8bb450f37ffc98af9def4d, which calls the portal contract (0x8d123a2a…) to trigger mints — no permissionless route.

controls.label: Goal3 owner EOA
controls.evidence: At zkSync Era block 70747617, owner() on 0xfc7e56298657b002b3e656400e746b7212912757 returned 0x49a67aff9d3807351b8bb450f37ffc98af9def4d. eth_getCode on that address returns no bytecode (EOA). All observed Transfer-from-zero events are triggered by this EOA calling Goal3 portal contract 0x8d123a2a0a7c98555931ceda6917b865b7345164. No proxy admin slot set on the token contract.

review.evidence: At zkSync Era block 70747617: owner() on the zkUSD token contract (0xfc7e5629…2757) returned 0x49a67aff9d3807351b8bb450f37ffc98af9def4d. eth_getCode confirms that address is an EOA. Mint events show this EOA calls Goal3 portal contract 0x8d123a2a0a7c98555931ceda6917b865b7345164 which then mints zkUSD. No recent mints (none in last ~3M blocks). EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = zero.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: zkUSD is presented as portal-issued and redeemable at one USDC, making it a reserve-style receipt rather than a borrower CDP.
